title: [EP-V0] receipt.v0 + run.v0: four-axis receipt and hash-linked run ledger, schemas, fixtures
description: CONSUMER: evidence-machine em-1ez (process adapter emits receipts), em-ky5 (ledger/journal). Four independent axes as enums: execution {ok,err,cancelled,panicked}, domain_disposition {positive,negative,refusal,not_applicable}, coverage {unattempted,partial,complete}, claim_state {supported,contradicted,conflicted,unresolved,forced}. Invalid fixture: a receipt collapsing refusal into execution=err must fail. run.v0: ordered receipts + plan patches + control events, hash-linked.

comments.author: Zac
comments.text: Consumer requirement from evidence-machine em-lnx (2026-09-16): receipt.v0 must allow a receipt with NO run/node context (run_id, node_id nullable or an explicit "standalone" variant) so a conformance receipt sealed at plan time can be content-addressed and later included in a pack closure as a lens. Add a valid fixture for the standalone form and an invalid fixture where run_id is present but node_id is missing.

title: [EP-V0] answer.v0: answer classes, coverage certificate, typed unknowns, closure refs; schema + fixtures
description: CONSUMER: evidence-machine em-36x (sealer/verifier) and em-1xd (Milestone 1 report). Answer classes per canon §4.7; unknown taxonomy per canon §7 (not_investigated … privacy_boundary) with can_change_answer + closing action; coverage certificate totals must reconcile (invalid fixture: total != sum). Per-subject basis vocabulary for the identity slice (constraint | anchor:<family> | reviewed) travels in the domain payload, NOT here — keep answer.v0 domain-agnostic.

title: [EP-V0] capability.v0: per-channel declaration (evidences / independence / conformance); schema + the five Milestone 1 fixtures
description: CONSUMER: evidence-machine em-lnx (reader + conformance runner) and em-13q (source selection). Fields: channel key (catalog identity), entity_grains, evidences[{from,to,predicate}], evidence_class enum {primary_observation,corroboration,constraint,external_anchor}, temporal_coverage, independence.upstream[], license, cost, conformance receipt ref, optional implementation_status (planned|shipped) for declared-but-unplannable channels (crucible cr-21o pattern). Fixtures = the five M1 channels in evidence-machine docs/MILESTONE_1.md §4, written as VALID declarations; plus an invalid one missing independence.

comments.author: Zac
comments.text: Storage decided 2026-09-15: declarations live ON the catalog channel record (metadata API), not in a sidecar. Shape capability.v0 so it serializes as the channel's declaration property verbatim (the catalog stores it, evidence-machine em-lnx reads it back, spine-rules validates it). Fixtures should be the five Milestone 1 channels exactly as they will appear on their channel records.
